newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf jet fuel firms again, Harbor seen flat.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf jet fuel firms again, Harbor seen flat.

text.p: Solid buying interest boosted U.S. Gulf jet fuel differentials modestly Tuesday, but New York Harbor differentials hovered near unchanged.
On the NYMEX, September heating oil futures gained 0.62 cent to settle at 55.71 cents a gallon.
"We've seen good, strong buying interest all month," one Gulf Coast player said. "It's definitely still well bid, but there are some sellers out there."
On the USG, prompt 54-grade jet fuel differentials traded at 0.80 and 0.90 cent over the NYMEX, a gain of about 0.10 cent from Monday.
New York Harbor differentials, however, hovered between about 3.10 and 3.35 cents over the September futures, flat with the previous day.
